item.title: Residents shares opinions about new BJ’s Wholesale Club coming to Ocala
item.description: "I am so happy we are finely getting a BJ's here. Going to Lady Lakes is a hassle. With the traffic getting there and back, you cannot buy some frozen items because they thaw before you get home. I can not wait for them to come here." - After Ocala-News.com reported that a new BJ's Wholesale Club is coming to Ocala, several residents wrote in to share their opinions about the matter. item.title: Marion woman sues HCA Florida for misdiagnosed ectopic pregnancy that ruptured, required emergency surgery
item.description: A Marion County woman has filed a medical malpractice lawsuit against two doctors, a medical group, and a hospital system, alleging that their failure to properly diagnose and treat an ectopic pregnancy resulted in a rupture and emergency surgery. item.title: We moved to Marion County because Sheriff Billy Woods is tougher on crime and we feel safer here.
item.description: "I am a 73-year-old homeowner in Marion County and I can tell you, my wife and I moved here from the Miami area and one of the things that stands out for us is all of the sheriff's departments in central Florida are all on the same page as far as law enforcement goes. We researched all the counties in the area and we chose Marion County due to sheriff Billy Woods and his no nonsense approach to law enforcement.
